centreville-baptist-church.assessment: Centreville Baptist Church under Dr. Josh Vincent is a solid SBC congregation with a clear disciple-making mission. Dr. Vincent arrived in September 2022 after 13 years as Lead Pastor at Trinity Bible Church in Phoenix, AZ, where he also served as Director of The Gospel Coalition Arizona. The Sunday structure (Community Groups + Equip Classes at 9 AM before the 10:30 AM worship gathering) shows a church that takes formation seriously. The statement of faith affirms biblical inerrancy, Trinity, salvation by grace through faith, believer's baptism by immersion, and a complementarian stance on marriage and gender. SBC of Virginia affiliation provides BF&M 2000 baseline accountability. For a man in Centreville, Chantilly, or the Route 29/Lee Highway corridor, CBC is a strong choice with clear mission identity and solid evangelical foundations.
